tasks.label: Start Tomcat (JPDA)
args: set -e; mvn -q -DskipTests package && rm -rf "/home/sempere/Bureau/work/apache-tomcat-9.0.74/webapps/Gigwa2" "/home/sempere/Bureau/work/apache-tomcat-9.0.74/webapps/Gigwa2.war" && cp target/*.war "/home/sempere/Bureau/work/apache-tomcat-9.0.74/webapps/Gigwa2.war" && unset CATALINA_BASE CATALINA_TMPDIR && export CATALINA_HOME="/home/sempere/Bureau/work/apache-tomcat-9.0.74" && exec "$CATALINA_HOME/bin/catalina.sh" jpda run

tasks.label: Stop Tomcat
args: unset CATALINA_BASE CATALINA_TMPDIR; export CATALINA_HOME="/home/sempere/Bureau/work/apache-tomcat-9.0.74"; exec "$CATALINA_HOME/bin/catalina.sh" stop
